query: You are given this Excel file as a map. You start on the START cell and move toward the END cell. You are allowed to move two cells per turn, and you may move up, down, left, or right. You may not move fewer than two cells, and you may not move backward. You must avoid moving onto any blue cells. On the eleventh turn, what is the 6-digit hex code (without prefix) of the color of the cell where you land after moving?

used_evidence: The Excel file does not provide the positions of the START and END cells or the colors of the cells.
follow_up_queries: What are the positions of the blue cells in the grid?
What are the exact coordinates of the START and END cells?

tasks.description: Determine the valid moves from the START cell, considering the movement rules and avoiding blue cells.

assumptions: The START cell is located at the top-left corner of the grid.
The movement rules allow movement to adjacent cells (up, down, left, right).
Blue cells are to be avoided, but their positions are not provided.
reasoning_steps: Identify the position of the START cell.
Determine the possible adjacent cells based on the movement rules.
Check if any of the adjacent cells are blue cells (which we cannot access).
List the valid moves based on the above checks.
conclusions: Without knowing the positions of the blue cells, it is impossible to definitively state which moves are valid.
proposed_answer_outline: List all adjacent cells to the START cell.
Indicate that valid moves depend on the presence of blue cells in those positions.
